title: “The Argument” podcast, ad free: What do we really know about Elizabeth Holmes?
gist: Paywalled podcast teaser: Yglesias and Jerusalem discuss the Elizabeth Holmes documentary 'You Can See Everything', with Matt arguing Holmes would seem more sympathetic if she admitted fault and Jerusalem noting the efficacy of her unapologetic victim stance. Little substantive content beyond the teaser.

insights.claim: Yglesias thinks Elizabeth Holmes might come across as more sympathetic if she were willing to admit some fault in her actions.
insights.speaker: Matthew Yglesias
insights.so_what: Reputation rehabilitation of fallen founders hinges on contrition — relevant to how markets and media treat disgraced tech figures.
